correctness.rationale: The claim fixes the full strong discrete Morse complex X_n of the path with n edges, rational reduced homology, and the actual incidence reversal r(2i)=2(n-1-i)+1. The forbidden-subword model avoids <> and <->, including downward-closed nonpure faces. Invariant faces consist of transposition pairs; signed augmented fixed-simplex count is -S_floor(n/2). The four-state transfer transitions yield S_{h+1}=-S_{h-1}, S0=1,S1=0. Combining the resulting Lefschetz values with Knudson–Owens–White concentration Htilde(X_4k)=Q in degree 2k-1, Htilde(X_4k+1)=Q in degree 2k gives reversal characters (-1)^k and (-1)^(k+1), respectively, with others zero. Boundary n=1 is two points and acts by -1; finite source verification independently corroborates face language/reflection for small n but all-n conclusion is the recurrence and cited source theorem.
